content.title: Dawn Staley Net Worth: How rich is the South Carolina women's basketball coach?
content.text: Dawn Staley isn't just a legend on the court; she's a financial powerhouse. As the head coach of the South Carolina Gamecocks, this hoops icon has built a multimillion-dollar empire. From the streets of Philly to becoming the first coach to lead her team to three consecutive NCAA title games (2024-2026), Staley's journey is a masterclass in excellence. Curious about her current standing in 2026?To watch this video, agree to share video information with third partiesAgree|More infoStaley's primary wealth comes from her historic tenure at South Carolina, where she has called the shots since 2008. Her current contract, signed in January 2025, is a five-year, $25.25 million deal. For the current 2025-26 season, her compensation has stepped up to $4.25 million, maintaining her status as the highest-paid coach in women's college basketball history"I'm proud to represent the University of South Carolina and its investment in women's basketball," she noted when the deal was finalized. This contract features a $250,000 annual escalator, meaning her pay will hit $4.5 million next season and climb to $5.25 million by 2029-30. It's a massive evolution from her $650,000 starting salary 18 years ago.Folgueiras lo tiene claro: "Aday Mara es el mejor pívot del baloncesto universitario"What's Dawn Staley's net worth in 2026?As of April 2026, Dawn Staley has an estimated net worth of $14 million. Her bank account has seen a significant boost from performance bonuses; her undefeated 38-0 season in 2024 and her runner-up finish in 2025 triggered six-figure payouts. By reaching the 2026 National Championship game, she has already secured at least $250,000 in additional bonuses this year alone."We've built something special here," she told reporters after yesterday's semifinal win over UConn. With three national championships (2017, 2022, 2024) and now seven Final Fours in the last 10 tournaments, her legacy is undisputed. Social media remains in awe: "Dawn isn't just coaching; she's running a dynasty," one fan posted after the Gamecocks clinched their spot in Sunday's final.Beyond the sidelines, Staley's portfolio is diverse. She holds major endorsement deals with brands like Aflac, rooted in her legendary playing career as a six-time WNBA All-Star and three-time Olympic gold medalist. Her Dawn Staley Foundation and popular "Netlife" podcast continue to expand her influence.While she often says, "It's not just about the money," her $14 million net worth reflects the market's realization of her value. From Virginia's record-setting point guard to the undisputed Queen of Columbia, Staley's empire is still growing-with another chance to add a fourth ring this Sunday.
